questions.def: Use 'had' after 'wish' to express a regret about the present.
questions.question: I wish I ___ more free time.

questions.def: Use 'had + past participle' after 'wish' for past regrets.
questions.question: She wishes she ___ harder in school.

questions.def: Use 'could' after 'wish' to express a desire for ability.
questions.question: I wish I can speak Spanish fluently.

questions.def: Use 'were' (not 'was') after 'wish' for hypothetical situations.
questions.question: I wish I ___ taller.

questions.def: Use 'had gone' after wish for past regrets.
questions.question: They wish they ___ to the party last night.

questions.def: Use 'hadn't + past participle' to express regret about past actions.
questions.question: He wishes he ___ so much money.

questions.def: Use 'would' after 'wish' to express a desire for someone's behaviour to change.
questions.question: I wish you will stop making noise.

questions.def: Use the past simple after 'wish' for present desires.
questions.question: I wish I ___ the answer.

questions.def: Use past simple (had) after 'wish' to express a desire for something.
questions.question: She wishes she ___ a car.

questions.def: Use past simple negative to express a wish about present situation.
questions.question: I wish I ___ so far away.

questions.def: Use 'were' instead of 'is' in 'wish' clauses expressing hypothetical.
questions.question: He wishes he is more confident.

questions.def: Use 'would + base form' after 'wish' for future desires, expecting change.
questions.question: I wish you ___ to my party.

questions.def: Use past simple negative after 'wish' for present wishes/regrets.
questions.question: I wish it ___ rain so much.

questions.def: Use past continuous after 'wish' to express regret about something ongoing.
questions.question: They wish they ___ harder now.

questions.def: Use 'could' after 'wish' to express ability or possibility.
questions.question: She wishes she can go abroad.

questions.def: Use past simple after 'wish' for present regrets.
questions.question: I wish I ___ more about history now.

questions.def: Use 'had been' after 'wish' for past regrets about being something.
questions.question: He wishes he ___ more careful.

questions.def: Use 'were' after wish to express a desire or unreal situation.
questions.question: I wish I ___ better at cooking.

questions.def: Use 'would' after 'wish' to express future desire or polite request.
questions.question: I wish you will help me tomorrow.

questions.def: Use 'hadn't + past participle' for past regrets.
questions.question: I wish I ___ so much cake.

questions.def: Use 'had + past participle' after wish for past regrets.
questions.question: She wishes she ___ to the beach with us.

questions.def: Use 'had' after 'wish' to express a desire for something now.
questions.question: I wish I ___ a new phone.

questions.def: Use past simple (had) after 'wish' for desires about the present.
questions.question: He wishes he has more friends.

questions.def: Use 'weren't' after wish to express a desire about the present.
questions.question: I wish I ___ so tired now.

questions.def: Use past simple (had) after 'wish' for a current desire.
questions.question: We wish we ___ enough money to travel.

questions.def: Use 'hadn't + past participle' for regrets about past actions.
questions.question: She wishes she ___ him.

questions.def: Use 'would + base form' after 'wish' to express a desire for change.
questions.question: I wish it stop raining soon.

questions.def: Use 'could' after wish to express a desire for ability.
questions.question: I wish I ___ fly.

questions.def: Use past simple (had) to express a current desire after 'wish'.
questions.question: They wish they ___ a bigger house.

questions.def: Use past simple negative for current desires / past regrets.
questions.question: He wishes he ___ so much.
